GOAT XI EDITIONS!

UPDATE: 
-A brand new team showcasing the Best XI Players in history!
-Within the Best XI team, a chance to unlock new GOAT Edition cards!
-GOAT Edition cards make Limitbreakers look silly!

Code: GOAT

OVER 1000 PLAYERS TO COLLECT! From 1970 to today, ROBLOX's best players are here to join up and play for YOUR team!

This is the first of its kind on ROBLOX, a unique football / soccer experience. Make sure to like, favorite, and join the group for better updates, more content, and in-game rewards.

THIS GAME IS IN EARLY BETA

Notice: Servers are shutdown occasionally during updates signified by the start and end of events. All players in this game are fictional. This game is a fan-made project and is not affiliated with, sponsored, or endorsed by any football organization, league, or professional player.
